title: Ribbit King
fan_note: A fan game after Bandai's Ribbit King (GameCube, 2003), made for a friend who loved it. Not affiliated with Bandai; every frog, course and picture here is new.
no_webgl: Ribbit King draws its courses with WebGL 2, which this browser does not offer. Try a recent Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
setup_hint: Click a frog to change it. Up to four frogs, people or CPU, take turns from the same tee.
course_full: Full round: all four holes, par {par}
prompt_aim: A D aim · W S power · Q loft · Space to swing
prompt_meter: Space to whack: stop the needle in the gold · X to go back
prompt_flight: W A S D steer · Space jump · E tongue
prompt_wings: Wings! A D bank · W dive · S climb

says.tongue_ready: 10 flies: tongue ready! E near a frog
says.got_jump: Extra jump! Space in the air

help_intro: Frolf is golf played with frogs. Each frog sits on a catapult; whack it with the mallet and the frog flies. Fewest strokes into the lotus wins, and the best frog on the card is crowned the Ribbit King.
help_rows: Aim with A and D (or the arrows), set the mallet's power with W and S, and change the loft with Q. The dotted arc shows where a perfect hit at that power first lands. Press Space: the needle starts round the dial. Press Space again to whack. In the gold is a perfect hit: full power, dead straight and a little extra. Elsewhere on the red bar is weaker, and early hooks left, late slices right. Off the bar is a whiff.
You fly your frog. W A S D steer it, relative to the camera. Drag the view with the mouse to look around.
Land on a lily pad or a spider web and it throws you back up. Webs throw harder.
The spring power-up. Press Space in the air to hop again. You can carry three.
Like the wing cap: glide for a few seconds. A and D bank, W dives to gain speed, S climbs.
Touch one and it goes off, blasting you up and away.
Lines of flies hang over every hole. Catch ten and your tongue is ready: press E with another frog in reach to knock it flying. Knock one into the water and it takes a penalty stroke.
Water, lava and out of bounds cost a stroke, and the frog goes back to where it was hit from.
Everyone tees off in order; after that, the frog farthest from the lotus plays next, as in golf. A hole is given up at five over par.
controls: Start the meter, whack; jump in the air
